tiers.name: Full Parameter + Optimizer CPU Offload (`offload_params=True`) + Vanilla `torch.optim.AdamW`
tiers.note: Streams weights over PCIe every forward/backward microstep and runs unvectorized multi-kernel PyTorch CPU Adam at step end -> 18.60s stall!

tiers.name: Keep BF16 Params on GPU + End-of-Backward Synchronous PCIe Grad Offload + Vanilla CPU Adam
tiers.note: Eliminates forward/backward PCIe weight traffic, but waits until all backward layers finish before copying grads and running slow CPU Adam!

tiers.name: Keep BF16 Params on GPU + End-of-Step Fused SIMD `AVX-512 DeepSpeedCPUAdam` (No Layerwise Overlap)
tiers.note: Single-pass AVX-512/OpenMP C++ kernel accelerates CPU Adam 5.6x, but end-of-step execution still leaves a 1.35s non-overlapped GPU wait.

tiers.name: Layerwise Overlapped `D2H` Grad Stream + Immediate `AVX-512 CPUAdam` during Backward (`Zero-Infinity / ZenFlow`)
tiers.note: As each layer's Reduce-Scatter finishes in backward, immediately streams grad shard via pinned D2H and runs AVX-512 CPUAdam concurrently with earlier layers' backward -> 3.45s step (5.39x faster)!
